name: Bold lines only
about: A note mixing bold and plain lines: Pick for me suggests the bold lines, plus scripture and quotes, and leaves the talking notes alone.

runs.text: God plants us where we can grow.
Tell the story of the oak in my grandmother’s yard and how it survived the storm.
Roots go down before fruit comes up.
Most of the growth happens where no one sees it.
Colossians 2:7 – rooted and built up in him and established in the faith.
“The tree that never had to fight for its sun never grew tall.”
